profile.headline: Software Engineer at Adobe
profile.summary: Experienced Computer Science Tutor with a with a Bachelor’s Degree focused in Software Engineering from Brigham Young University - Idaho. Skilled in leading a small team. Enjoy building mobile applications and Back-End development.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
• Provided assistance with migrating Angular projects to React in order to improve maintainability 
• Taught team members that were new to React.js through pair-programming sessions resulting in improved understanding of React.js
• Automated a series of tasks, handled by an individual, that saved an average of 2-3 hours per day
• Optimized code to run from 12 hours to 40 minutes by refactoring method calls and loops

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
• Collaborated with Managers and Tech Leads on the architecture council which addressed the implications of moving the entire company to React.js and away from Polymer
• Utilized Storybook to build a React.js component library to implement a new UI and UX for the company to use
• Incorporated Jest, and React Testing Library into the component library to encourage developers to write quality code 
• Designed, developed, and deployed a dashboard showing React.js adoption data from GitHub
Produced documentation with Docz.site to provide a single resource for learning React.js core concepts accompanied with examples

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
•	Tutored students in a one-on-one setting covering data structures, OOP, and the fundamentals of C++ 
•	Created personalized learning plans tailored to students’ needs that improved their understanding and overall GPA by an average of 0.25 points

positions.title: Logistics Team Member
positions.description: Assisted with the day-to-day logistics of the store.
